[SWS_DM_01398] SOVD operation proximity_challenge
⌈
If the SOVD
attribute proximity_proof_required of a SOVD operation is true the Diagnostic
Server Instance shall return the attribute proximity_challenge in the response
body of SOVD method Get Details of a Single Operation using ara::-
diag::SovdProximityChallenge::GetChallenge, else the attribute proxim-
ity_challenge shall not be supported in the response body.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01398] SOVD operation proximity_challenge
⌈
If the SOVD attribute proximity_proof_required of a SOVD operation is true
the Diagnostic Server Instance shall return the attribute proximity_challenge in
the response body of SOVD method Get Details of a Single Operation us-
ing ara::diag::SovdProximityChallenge::GetChallenge, else the attribute
proximity_challenge shall not be supported in the response body.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01398] Providing the SOVD operation proximity_challenge
⌈
If a SOVD operation has DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximityProofRe-
quired set to TRUE, in each response body where the attribute proxim-
ity_challenge is required, the Diagnostic Server instance shall return the
attribute in the response body of the SOVD method with the value returned by ara::
diag::SovdProximityChallenge::GetChallenge.
⌋
